description: This file contains utility functions for reading the contents of a file into memory and printing input/output data, specifically for testing purposes. It includes a function to read a file into a memory buffer and a function to print the input data or contents of a file for debugging or verification.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the specified file into a provided memory buffer structure, handling errors and allocating memory dynamically.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints contents of a file or a given string, mainly for debugging, using the read_file_into_memory function to load file content before printing.
